source: Nested random-effects analysis of variance, expected mean squares as in handbook 6.6.1.3

overstatement.meaning: A capability index is inversely proportional to the sigma it uses. With the sigma of the X-bar and s chart (within wafers), any Cp or Cpk for single sites would come out this many times larger than with the sigma of all three sources together.

noSpecification: The case study publishes no specification limits for line width, so no capability index is computed for it.
